Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the search result and incorrectly concluded that Thailand was the host of the 2020 AFC U-23 Championship qualification. The Wikipedia snippet clearly showed multiple host countries for the qualification phase and that Thailand was the host of the final tournament. This conflation led to an incorrect downstream chain (choosing the wrong “boundary nation” and ultimately the wrong wood), causing the final solution to be wrong.
